inputs.original_text: This situation in Nigeria is yet another example of how the hidden elites are manipulating democracy to their advantage. Political parties are no longer platforms for the people but have become exclusive clubs for the wealthy. The latest developments within the ruling APC ahead of the 2027 general elections show that this is all part of a coordinated scheme to control the system and exclude ordinary citizens. They want us to see it as just an underexamined trend, but it's clearly a deliberate strategy to keep power concentrated at the top through deception and institutional capture.
inputs.modified_text: Man, this Nigeria thing is straight out of the elites' playbook to rig democracy from the inside. Political parties like the APC aren't for regular people anymore—they're just gated clubs for the wealthy to hoard everything. Those latest moves ahead of the 2027 elections aren't random or some overlooked trend like they'd prefer we believe. It's a deliberate, coordinated operation to lock down the system, shut out ordinary citizens, and keep all the power concentrated at the top through lies and institutional takeover.
